NeoVM Android — third-party runtime notices

1. QEMU runtime
The ARM64 QEMU executables are sourced from the Pockr project bundle at the pinned commit below. QEMU is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 2; consult the upstream QEMU source and license for the applicable terms.
Source project: https://github.com/AI2TH/Pockr
Pinned commit: f6d43483cc519987b4048962ea96303d99f3030d
QEMU project: https://www.qemu.org/
QEMU source: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu
The Pockr project is archived; the runtime has not been independently rebuilt or audited by NeoVM.

2. Pockr project files
The Pockr project is licensed under the MIT License. The accompanying POCKR-MIT-LICENSE.txt contains its license text.
Source: https://github.com/AI2TH/Pockr

3. Other bundled shared libraries
The ARM64 runtime bundle contains third-party shared libraries with their own license terms. Users redistributing the APK should review the pinned upstream repository and the licenses for each bundled dependency. This notice is not legal advice.

NeoVM does not claim to be affiliated with VMware, QEMU, or AI2TH/Pockr.

4. AArch64 UEFI firmware
The QEMU_EFI.fd firmware is obtained from the Ubuntu qemu-efi-aarch64 package during the GitHub Actions build. It is based on TianoCore EDK II. Review the package metadata and upstream EDK II license for the exact applicable license and notices.
Ubuntu package: https://packages.ubuntu.com/
EDK II source: https://github.com/tianocore/edk2
